note: Verified public emergency shelters, food pantries, and evacuation centers in Williamson County and Central Texas (TX-31). Coordinates verified for distance calculations.

places.name: Leander Public Library & Community Center Safe Room

description.en: FEMA-rated reinforced concrete safe room with backup battery lighting and emergency weather radio.
description.es: Refugio de concreto reforzado certificado por FEMA con iluminación de emergencia y radio meteorológico.

openNote.en: Opens immediately upon NWS Tornado Watch or Severe Warning issuance.
openNote.es: Abre de inmediato al emitirse alerta o vigilancia de tornado por el NWS.

places.name: SW Williamson County Regional Park Shelter Pavilion

description.en: Designated storm haven at park operations building, reinforced interior core.
description.es: Zona de protección designada en el edificio operativo del parque, núcleo interior reforzado.

openNote.en: Open 24/7 for CR 175 corridor neighborhood emergencies.
openNote.es: Abierto 24/7 para emergencias del vecindario en el corredor CR 175.

places.name: Rouse High School Storm Safe Haven

description.en: Interior windowless concrete structure with emergency medical supplies.
description.es: Estructura interior de concreto sin ventanas con suministros médicos de emergencia.

openNote.es: Punto de reunión comunitario designado ante tornados.

places.name: Cedar Park Recreation Center Safe Hall

description.en: Reinforced municipal storm shelter with backup generator and emergency supply cache.
description.es: Refugio municipal reforzado con generador auxiliar y reserva de suministros de emergencia.

places.name: Hill Country Community Ministries (HCCM) Food Pantry

description.en: Emergency groceries, canned proteins, baby formula, bottled drinking water and fresh produce for Leander & Cedar Park families.
description.es: Alimentos de emergencia, proteínas enlatadas, fórmula para bebés, agua potable y productos frescos para familias locales.

openNote.en: Mon-Fri 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM. Emergency walk-in disaster boxes provided.
openNote.es: Lunes a viernes 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM. Entrega de cajas de emergencia sin cita.

places.name: Central Texas Food Bank - Mobile Relief Hub

description.en: Dispatches 7-day emergency shelf-stable meal kits, gallon water jugs, and nutrition supplies during disaster declarations.
description.es: Distribuye paquetes de comida no perecedera para 7 días, garrafones de agua y víveres durante emergencias declaradas.

openNote.en: Dispatches mobile emergency food truck during severe weather events.
openNote.es: Envía camión móvil de distribución durante eventos de clima severo.

places.name: Open My World / Bagdad Emergency Food Outreach

description.en: Community pantry stocked with dry staples, shelf-stable milk, peanut butter, and ready-to-eat supplies.
description.es: Despensa comunitaria con granos secos, leche no perecedera, crema de cacahuate y alimentos listos para comer.

openNote.en: Active during community storm recovery operations.
openNote.es: Activo durante operaciones comunitarias de recuperación tras tormentas.

places.name: Kelly Reeves Athletic Complex (Williamson County Evacuation Center)

description.en: American Red Cross designated coastal hurricane evacuation hub with cots, hot meals, medical triage, and pet sheltering.
description.es: Centro de evacuación designado por la Cruz Roja ante huracanes costeros con catres, comida caliente, primeros auxilios y albergue para mascotas.

openNote.en: Primary regional shelter reception center for Central Texas evacuees.
openNote.es: Centro regional principal de recepción de evacuados en el centro de Texas.

places.name: Georgetown Community Center Hurricane Evacuation Hub

description.en: Williamson County regional hurricane shelter equipped with emergency generator, commercial kitchen, shower facilities, and family reunification desks.
description.es: Refugio regional de Williamson County con generador de emergencia, cocina comercial, duchas y mesas de reunificación familiar.

openNote.en: Operated by Williamson County Emergency Management during Hurricane events.
openNote.es: Operado por Manejo de Emergencias del Condado ante huracanes.

places.name: Austin Convention Center State Mega-Shelter
places.address: 500 E Cesar Chavez St, Austin, TX 78701

description.en: State of Texas designated mega-shelter facility for massive Gulf Coast hurricane relief along the I-35 corridor.
description.es: Megarefugio oficial del Estado de Texas para auxilio masivo por huracanes en la Costa del Golfo a lo largo del corredor I-35.

openNote.en: Capacity up to 2,500 people with emergency medical, FEMA, and multi-agency support.
openNote.es: Capacidad de hasta 2,500 personas con atención médica, FEMA y apoyo de múltiples agencias.

places.name: Leander City Hall & Activity Center Warming Hub

description.en: Emergency municipal warming station with auxiliary generator power, warm blankets, device charging, and hot drinks during severe freeze emergencies.
description.es: Estación de calefacción municipal de emergencia con generador auxiliar, cobijas térmicas, carga de celulares y bebidas calientes.

openNote.en: Activated when temperatures drop below 32°F or during ERCOT winter grid emergencies.
openNote.es: Activado cuando la temperatura baja de 32°F o durante emergencias de la red eléctrica ERCOT.

places.name: Cedar Park Library & Recreation Warming & Charging Hub

description.en: Regional winter warming hall with power backup and oxygen machine recharge outlets.
description.es: Salón regional de abrigo ante frío con energía de respaldo y enchufes para concentradores de oxígeno.

openNote.en: Open 24 hours during County emergency winter declarations.
openNote.es: Abierto las 24 horas durante declaraciones de emergencia invernal del Condado.

description.en: Air-conditioned cooling center with chilled bottled water and hydration stations during extreme heat waves.
description.es: Centro de enfriamiento con aire acondicionado, agua embotellada fría y estaciones de hidratación durante olas de calor extremo.

openNote.en: Open daily during NWS Heat Advisories and Excessive Heat Warnings.
openNote.es: Abierto durante avisos de calor y advertencias de calor excesivo del NWS.

places.name: Cedar Park Recreation Center Cooling Haven

description.en: Municipal cooling shelter with medical nurse on duty, cooling towels, and ice water distribution.
description.es: Refugio municipal de enfriamiento con enfermería de guardia, toallas frías y distribución de agua con hielo.

openNote.es: Activo cuando el índice de calor supera los 105°F.
